title: Mask Adoption and Epidemic Interaction Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads through a population, how policies, social influence, supply, and information shape adoption, and how adoption affects infectious disease transmission.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People adjust belief and mask-wearing propensity based on the behaviors and beliefs of peers and household members.

interactions.name: policy_broadcast_and_compliance
interactions.description: Authorities announce mandates and campaigns; people adjust compliance; locations enforce policies resulting in entry denial or fines.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People buy masks from retailers subject to inventory and price; subsidies can lower effective price.

interactions.name: information_and_misinformation
interactions.description: Media nodes and social sharing alter risk perception, trust, and adoption likelihood.

interactions.name: contact_and_transmission
interactions.description: When people co-locate, they make contacts; infection probability per contact is reduced by mask efficacy of source and recipient and location-specific contact multipliers.

metrics.name: adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate observed during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Days elapsed until 70% of the population wears masks.

metrics.name: effective_Rt
metrics.description: Estimated effective reproduction number over time given contact patterns and masking.

metrics.name: daily_incidence
metrics.description: Number of new infections per day.

metrics.name: cumulative_infections_averted
metrics.description: Cumulative infections avoided relative to a no-mask baseline.

metrics.name: compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of people complying with policy mandates at locations requiring masks.

metrics.name: stockout_frequency
metrics.description: Number or fraction of days retailers experience zero mask inventory.

metrics.name: average_mask_price
metrics.description: Average transaction price of masks over time.

metrics.name: equity_gap_adoption
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between lowest and highest income quintiles.

metrics.name: enforcement_events
metrics.description: Count of fines or enforcement actions issued.

metrics.name: campaign_reach
metrics.description: Proportion of population exposed to public health messaging.

metrics.name: npi_cost_total
metrics.description: Total cost associated with masks (purchases, subsidies, fines) over the simulation.
